* '''Real name: '''Piotr'''
* '''Date of birth:''' 1982 
* '''Nationality:''' [[Image:flag_pl.gif]] Polish
* '''City:'''[[Image:flag_pl.gif]] Warsaw
* '''First spawned:''' [[1996]]  - since the beginning of Q1
* '''First clan:''' [[Image:flag_pl.gif]] [[Sons of Anarchy]]. Created by: [[Image:flag_pl.gif]] [[Insane]], [[Image:flag_pl.gif]] [[Avenger]] , [[Image:flag_pl.gif]] [[Szturm]] , [[Image:flag_pl.gif]] [[Shamoth]]
* '''Current clan:''' [[Image:flag_pl.gif]] [[Death Dealers]]

__________________________________________________________________
* Polish Quake1 player (only). 
* One of the first Warsaw Quake players. 
* Focused on teamplay games.
* '''Favourite Map in 4on4:''' [[Dm2]]
* Foavourite other mode: 'Clana Arena' played in 4/4 on LAN. 
__________________________________________________________________
* Got break from all QW related stuff from '''2005'''. 
* Few short comebacks in : '''2011''', '''2013''' and longer episode in '''2015-2017''',
* Last comeback '''12.2022''' .
* NOW: '''Active'''!
